description: Lagrangian Tropical Cyclone Precipitation Estimates and Moisture Sources (LagTCPMoS) Dataset is a data set described in a peer-reviewed Scientific Data article written by Albenis Pérez-Alarcón et al. This work presents a Lagrangian tropical cyclone (TC) precipitation estimates and moisture sources (LagTCPMoS) dataset in the North Atlantic basin from 1980 to 2023. TC tracks were obtained from the U.S. Coverage: not stated; published in 2025. Formats: NetCDF. The data are held in Zenodo and reached through its DOI listed on this page; the paper's Data Records section names it. Access is free of charge and open according to the article. The licence is CC-BY-4.0, taken from DataCite rights of the deposit. Caveats: written from the Scientific Data article metadata (title, abstract, Data Records section) read on 2026-10-01; the data themselves were not opened or downloaded, so their contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support multi-sector infrastructure risk and planning studies. Related records: none catalogued yet.
